## Does it stay inside the boundary?

RecordMint records in the browser and nowhere else, video bytes never pass through
the app server, and nothing in the worker may be required for a share link to work.
Explain how this proposal fits those three rules.

A proposal that needs a native desktop application will not be accepted.

## Self-hosting cost

Does this add a service to the compose file, a background job, or storage per
recording? A self-hosted product is judged by how much its operator has to run.
